info.title: MCP Reports API Specification
info.description: IQM Reports API for custom, ad-hoc, saved, and scheduled report construction and delivery. Use these tools to select dimensions, metrics, columns, filters, templates, reporting periods, and email schedules.

post.summary: Run (execute) a custom report and return its rows and totals
post.description:
Report-builder routing: Use this IQM Reports API tool to create, configure, save, execute, schedule, email, list, or manage a custom report. Use it for report dimensions, metrics, columns, filters, templates, and reporting periods. Runs a saved or ad-hoc report and returns its rows and totals in the response; it does not save anything (to export a CSV or XLSX file use downloadReport). Run a saved report by `id`, or an ad-hoc report by sending `dimensions`, `columns`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `timezoneId`, `timezoneName`, `requestType` and `reportAggregated`. The response `data` contains `data` (one row per dimension combination, only rows with impressions; omitted when there are no rows), `total` (a single totals row) and `totalRecords` (number of rows across all pages). Rows are paginated with `pageNo` and `noOfEntries` and sorted by `sortBy` (default `-impressions`). Daily rows include a `date` (MM/DD/YYYY); weekly and monthly rows include a `dateRange`. Dates are epoch milliseconds (end after start; at most 365 days apart), and `timezoneName` controls how they are bucketed into days, weeks and months. Metrics that require the finance permission return 0 for users without it. **Request Body Description:** | **Field** | **Type** | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | | id | Integer | [Optional] - Run a saved report by its ID. When supplied, the saved definition replaces dimensions, columns, customerIds, startDate, endDate, timezoneId, timezoneName, requestType and reportAggregated; only pageNo, noOfEntries, sortBy, searchField, filters and resultType are read from the request. | | dimensions | JSON String | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - JSON string representing dimension details. | | columns | Array of String | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Metrics for showing serving result. Must be exact `key` values from GET /api/v3/ra/report/dimension-metrics/detail's `metrics` -- each category in that array (e.g. "Counts") maps to a list of metric objects, and `key` is a field on each of those objects. No fuzzy or case-insensitive matching. | | customerIds | Array of Integer | [Optional] - Workspace users: customers assigned to the user to include; omit to include all assigned customers. Ignored for advertiser users. | | filters | Object | [Optional] - Additional filters, distinct from per-dimension value filtering. Known keys: campaignIds (array of Integer), creativeTypeIds (array of Integer), campaignStatuses (array of String, e.g. "running"/"expired"; only applied when the report has a campaign or campaignStatus dimension). | | searchField | String | [Optional] - Text matched (case-insensitive, partial) against the names, and numeric IDs, of the report's dimension values, e.g. campaign names. | | requestType | Integer | [Required unless `id` is supplied; no default is applied if omitted] - Time breakdown of the rows.
sample : [1 - Daily, 2 - Aggregated (no time breakdown), 3 - Weekly, 4 - Monthly] | | reportAggregated | String | [Required unless `id` is supplied; no default is applied if omitted] - "1" aggregates over the first dimension (it is left out of the grouping); "0" groups by every dimension.
sample : [0- Not aggregated, 1- Aggregated] | | startDate | Long | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Report start time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.| | endDate | Long | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Report end time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be after startDate and at most 365 days later.| | timezoneId | Integer | [Required unless `id` is supplied; no default is applied if omitted] - Timezone ID| | timezoneName | String | [Required unless `id` is supplied; no default is applied if omitted] - Timezone name used to bucket dates into days, weeks and months, e.g. US/Eastern. With `id`, the saved report's timezone is used.| | sortBy | String | [Optional] - Field to sort by. Prefix with minus(-) for descending or plus(+) for ascending; no prefix sorts descending. Only one field is used.
Default value is '-impressions'| | pageNo | Integer | [Optional] - Page number, 1 or greater.
Default value is 1| | noOfEntries | Integer | [Optional] - The maximum number of returned results per page.
Default value is 50|

post.summary: Download (export) a custom report as a CSV or XLSX file
post.description:
Report-builder routing: Use this IQM Reports API tool to create, configure, save, execute, schedule, email, list, or manage a custom report. Use it for report dimensions, metrics, columns, filters, templates, and reporting periods. Runs a saved or ad-hoc report and exports it as a CSV or XLSX file, returning a temporary download URL in `data.url`; it does not save anything (to get rows in the response use executeReportData). The URL is set to expire after 3 hours, and `url` is null if the file could not be uploaded. The request body is the same as executeReportData: run a saved report by `id`, or define an ad-hoc report in the request (`dimensions`, `columns`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `timezoneId`, `timezoneName`, `requestType` and `reportAggregated`). `fileType` is always required: 1 = CSV, 2 = XLSX. The file contains up to 20,000 rows in `sortBy` order; `pageNo` and `noOfEntries` do not limit the download. Columns for the report's dimensions are added to the file automatically, plus a `date` column for daily reports or a `dateRange` column for weekly and monthly reports (except when `reportAggregated` is "1" with a single dimension). When the report has a name, the file starts with the report name and time range. XLSX files end with a totals row; CSV files have no totals row. **Request Body Details:** | **Field** | **Type** | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | | fileType | Integer | [Required] - File format of the download.
sample : [1 - CSV, 2 - XLSX] | | id | Integer | [Optional] - Run a saved report by its ID. When supplied, the saved definition replaces dimensions, columns, customerIds, startDate, endDate, timezoneId, timezoneName, requestType and reportAggregated. | | dimensions | JSON String | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - JSON string representing dimension details. | | columns | Array of String | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Metric keys to include in the file. | | customerIds | Array of Integer | [Optional] - Workspace users: customers assigned to the user to include; omit to include all assigned customers. Ignored for advertiser users. | | requestType | Integer | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Time breakdown of the rows.
sample : [1 - Daily, 2 - Aggregated (no time breakdown), 3 - Weekly, 4 - Monthly] | | reportAggregated | String | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - "1" aggregates over the first dimension (it is left out of the grouping); "0" groups by every dimension.
sample : [0- Not aggregated, 1- Aggregated] | | startDate | Long | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Report start time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. | | endDate | Long | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Report end time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be after startDate and at most 365 days later. | | timezoneId | Integer | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Timezone ID| | timezoneName | String | [Required unless `id` is supplied] - Timezone name used to bucket dates, e.g. US/Eastern| | sortBy | String | [Optional] - Field to sort by. Prefix with minus(-) for descending or plus(+) for ascending; no prefix sorts descending.
Default value is '-impressions'| | pageNo | Integer | [Optional] - Must be 1 or greater. Does not limit the download.
Default value is 1| | noOfEntries | Integer | [Optional] - Does not limit the download, which contains up to 20,000 rows.
Default value is 50|

Report-builder routing: Use this IQM Reports API tool to create, configure, save, execute, schedule, email, list, or manage a custom report. Use it for report dimensions, metrics, columns, filters, templates, and reporting periods. This API saves the report scheduling event. **Request Body Description:** | **Filed** | **Type** | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | | reportId | Integer | [Required] - This is report Id, event will be created on this report id. | | subscriberEmails | Array of String | [Required] - List of the emails on which the report will be sent. | | fileType | Integer | [Required] - Report file type id. The report will be sent in the selected file format .
sample : [1 - CSV, 2 - XLS]| | deliveryFrequency | Integer | [Required] - Delivery frequency type id for the emails to be sent.
sample : [1 - ONCE, 2 - DAILY, 3 - WEEKLY, 4 - MONTHLY] | | deliveryDay | String | [Required, if deliveryFrequency is not ONCE] - Delivery day to specify the day-time when the report should be sent.
This is related to Delivery frequency.
WEEKLY DELIVERY DAY: ["SUNDAY", "MONDAY", ...]
MONTHLY DELIVERY DAY: ["FIRST", "LAST", "2", "3", ..., "29"]| | eventEndDate | Long | [Required, if deliveryFrequency is not ONCE] - This should be a long, TIME EPOCH in UNIX format, in milliseconds.
This is events end date, Scheduled report will be stopped after the eventEndDate is exceeded | | runningTotalEnabled | Boolean | [Optional] - Flag to indicate if the 'Total' Running is enabled for the report. This flag is supported only with 'Campaign' dimension.
If this is true the start-date for the report duration should be the EARLIEST campaign start date,
so the report-time-period will be from the Earliest-campaign-start-date to the report-end-date | | earliestCampaignStartDate | Long | [Required with runningTotalEnabled as 'true'] - This should be a long, TIME EPOCH in UNIX format, in milliseconds.
This is campaign's EARLIEST start date from the selected campaigns, which will be set as the start date of the report-time-period. |

get.description: Report-builder routing: Use this IQM Reports API tool to create, configure, save, execute, schedule, email, list, or manage a custom report. Use it for report dimensions, metrics, columns, filters, templates, and reporting periods. This API offers Dimension and Metrics information grouped by Category in predetermined order. Current group names (e.g. "Budget", "Performance", "Spending", "Cost", "Video", "Conversion" for metrics; "Insertion Order Specifics", "Campaign Specifics", "Creative Specifics", "Demographics", "Technologies", "Deliveries", "Locations", "Audience Specifics" for dimensions) are not a fixed enum -- read them from this response rather than hardcoding a list. Individual metrics can be conditionally present or absent depending on the requesting organization's configuration (e.g. "VLD Insights Cost" only appears for orgs with VLD enabled on a political vertical; "Organization Bid Shading Savings" only appears when bid-shading is enabled) -- a metric's absence for a given org is expected, config-dependent behavior, not a spec gap. Each dimension's `isFilterSupported` indicates whether it can be restricted to specific values via `dimensions[].value` on POST /api/v3/ra/report/execute, not just grouped by.

post.description:
Report-builder routing: Use this IQM Reports API tool to create, configure, save, execute, schedule, email, list, or manage a custom report. Use it for report dimensions, metrics, columns, filters, templates, and reporting periods.

Saves a new report definition without running it and returns its ID in `data` (to copy an existing report use duplicateReport; to change one use updateReport). Run it afterwards with executeReportData or downloadReport using that `id`.

Required: `reportName` (up to 255 characters), `dimensions`, `columns`, `startDate` and `endDate` (epoch milliseconds; end after start; at most 365 days apart), `timezoneId`, `requestType` and `reportAggregated`. Dimension and column keys must exactly match keys from getDimensionAndMetricDetails for the caller's organization type.

Customers: for workspace users, `customerIds` must be customers assigned to the user; omit it to include all assigned customers. For advertiser users `customerIds` is ignored.

`reportSchedulingEventDetails` is validated if sent but is not saved: no schedule or email is created. To schedule emails, create the report first and then call saveReportScheduleEvent with the new report ID. `timezoneName` is not stored; the saved report's timezone comes from `timezoneId`.

post.description:
Report-builder routing: Use this IQM Reports API tool to create, configure, save, execute, schedule, email, list, or manage a custom report. Use it for report dimensions, metrics, columns, filters, templates, and reporting periods.

Copies an existing saved report (`id`, required) into a new saved report, optionally renamed, and returns a message containing the new report ID; it does not run the report (to define a new report from scratch use saveReport).

Everything except the name is copied from the original: dimensions, columns, dates, customers, timezone, `requestType` and `reportAggregated`. The new report is named `reportName` if sent (up to 255 characters), otherwise "Copy of <original name>". Email schedules are not copied. All other request fields are ignored; to change the copy, call updateReport afterwards.

The original report must belong to the caller's organization, and for workspace users all of its customers must be assigned to the user.

patch.summary: Update (edit) fields of a saved custom report
patch.description:
Report-builder routing: Use this IQM Reports API tool to create, configure, save, execute, schedule, email, list, or manage a custom report. Use it for report dimensions, metrics, columns, filters, templates, and reporting periods.

Changes fields of an existing saved report: a partial update of the report identified by the `reportId` path parameter. It does not run the report (to create a new report use saveReport or duplicateReport).

Only fields sent with a meaningful value change: non-blank `reportName` (up to 255 characters) and `dimensions`, non-empty `columns` and `customerIds`, positive `startDate`, `endDate`, `timezoneId` and `requestType` (1-4), and `reportAggregated` ("0" or "1"). Omitted fields keep their saved values. An empty `dimensions` string or empty `columns` list is rejected.

Dates follow the same rules as create (epoch milliseconds; end after start; at most 365 days apart). If only one date is sent, it is checked against the saved value of the other. Unlike create, edit does not check dimension and column keys against the allowed list, so use the exact keys from getDimensionAndMetricDetails.

Customers: workspace users may send `customerIds` (customers assigned to them), or `[]` to use all assigned customers. Advertiser users must not send `customerIds`. Changing `timezoneId` also updates the timezone of the report's email schedule, if it has one. `reportSchedulingEventDetails` is ignored; manage schedules with the report email schedule operations. The report must belong to the caller's organization.

earliestCampaignStartDate.description: Earliest start date from selected campaigns (required when runningTotalEnabled = true)

reportId.description: ID of the report to schedule. Used by the report email schedule operations; ignored when nested in a create-report request.

deliveryFrequency.description: Delivery frequency: 1 = once ; 2 = daily ; 3 = weekly ; 4 = monthly

subscriberEmails.description: Email addresses that receive the scheduled report. At least one is required.

items.description: Email addresses that receive the scheduled report. At least one is required.

eventEndDate.description: When the schedule stops, as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Required for daily, weekly and monthly schedules (deliveryFrequency 2, 3 or 4) and must not be in the past; not used for one-time delivery.

deliveryDay.description: Day the report is sent. Required for weekly (a day name, e.g. "Monday") and monthly ("FIRST", "LAST" or a day of the month from 1 to 28) schedules; not used for once or daily.

runningTotalEnabled.description: Running total: when true, the scheduled report period runs from earliestCampaignStartDate to the report end date. Supported only with the campaign dimension. Defaults to false.

ReportSchedulingEventDetailsVO.description: Email schedule settings. When creating a report these are validated but not saved: no schedule or email is created. Create the report first, then call saveReportScheduleEvent (POST /api/v3/ra/report/email/schedule) with the new report ID. Ignored by duplicate and edit.

id.description: Saved report ID. Execute and download: run the saved report with this ID; its saved definition replaces dimensions, columns, customerIds, startDate, endDate, timezoneId, timezoneName, requestType and reportAggregated, so none of those are needed. Duplicate: required; the report to copy. Ignored by create, and by edit (which takes the ID from the path).

reportName.description: Report name, up to 255 characters. Required when creating a report. Optional on duplicate (defaults to "Copy of <original name>") and edit. Download uses it in the file name and header; execute ignores it.

startDate.description: Start of the report date range as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds (not seconds). Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

endDate.description: End of the report date range as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds (not seconds). Must be after startDate and at most 365 days later. Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

dimensions.description: Dimensions to filter by. JSON-serialized array of objects, each with a mandatory `filter` and optional `value` array -- `filter` alone groups by that dimension; adding `value` restricts results to those specific values (only supported for dimensions where DimensionDetailsVO.isFilterSupported is true, per GET /api/v3/ra/report/dimension-metrics/detail; the server does not enforce this). `filter` must be an exact dimension `key` from that endpoint. Example JSON (before stringifying): [{"filter":"campaign"},{"filter":"gender","value":[10200002]}]. Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

customerIds.description: Customer (advertiser) organization IDs to include. Workspace users: must be customers assigned to the user; omit (or send [] on edit) to include all assigned customers. Advertiser users: ignored on create, execute and download, and must not be sent on edit.

items.description: Customer (advertiser) organization IDs to include. Workspace users: must be customers assigned to the user; omit (or send [] on edit) to include all assigned customers. Advertiser users: ignored on create, execute and download, and must not be sent on edit.

columns.description: List of columns to be included in the report. Must be exact `key` values from GET /api/v3/ra/report/dimension-metrics/detail's `metrics` -- each category in that array (e.g. "Counts") maps to a list of metric objects, and `key` is a field on each of those objects (e.g. "impressions", not "Impressions" or "impression count") -- there is no fuzzy or case-insensitive matching. Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`. Metrics that require the finance permission return 0 for users without it.

items.description: List of columns to be included in the report. Must be exact `key` values from GET /api/v3/ra/report/dimension-metrics/detail's `metrics` -- each category in that array (e.g. "Counts") maps to a list of metric objects, and `key` is a field on each of those objects (e.g. "impressions", not "Impressions" or "impression count") -- there is no fuzzy or case-insensitive matching. Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`. Metrics that require the finance permission return 0 for users without it.

timezoneId.description: ID of the timezone for the report, e.g. 29 = US/Eastern. This is the timezone stored with a saved report. No default is applied if omitted: required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

requestType.description: Time breakdown of the report rows: 1=daily, 2=aggregated (no time breakdown), 3=weekly (Sunday-Saturday), 4=monthly. No default is applied if omitted: required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

reportAggregated.description: Aggregation of the report rows, as the string "0" or "1". "0" groups rows by every dimension. "1" aggregates over the first dimension: it is left out of the grouping and its columns are empty. No default is applied if omitted: required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

owId.description: Organization (OW) ID that owns the report. Set by the server from the caller's session.

createdByUOWId.description: User (UOW) ID that created the report. Set by the server.

modifiedByUOWId.description: User (UOW) ID that last modified the report. Set by the server.

timezoneName.description: Timezone name used to bucket report dates into days, weeks and months, e.g. "US/Eastern". No default is applied: required when executing or downloading without `id` (with `id`, the saved report's timezone is used). Not stored by create or edit; set timezoneId instead.

organizationName.description: Name of the organization. Set by the server; used in download file names.

resultType.description: Which parts of the result to return: "data" (rows only) or "total" (totals row only). Omit to return both; leave unset for downloads.

fileType.description: Download file format: 1=CSV, 2=XLSX. Required for downloadReport; ignored by executeReportData.

additionalProperties.description: Additional server-side filters, distinct from the value-based filtering available on individual `dimensions` entries. Known keys: `campaignIds` (List<Integer>), `creativeTypeIds` (List<Integer>), `campaignStatuses` (List<String>, e.g. "running"/"expired"; only applied when the report has a campaign or campaignStatus dimension). Other keys are ignored. Example: {"campaignIds": [123, 234], "creativeTypeIds": [11], "campaignStatuses": ["running"]}

items.description: Additional server-side filters, distinct from the value-based filtering available on individual `dimensions` entries. Known keys: `campaignIds` (List<Integer>), `creativeTypeIds` (List<Integer>), `campaignStatuses` (List<String>, e.g. "running"/"expired"; only applied when the report has a campaign or campaignStatus dimension). Other keys are ignored. Example: {"campaignIds": [123, 234], "creativeTypeIds": [11], "campaignStatuses": ["running"]}

filters.description: Additional server-side filters, distinct from the value-based filtering available on individual `dimensions` entries. Known keys: `campaignIds` (List<Integer>), `creativeTypeIds` (List<Integer>), `campaignStatuses` (List<String>, e.g. "running"/"expired"; only applied when the report has a campaign or campaignStatus dimension). Other keys are ignored. Example: {"campaignIds": [123, 234], "creativeTypeIds": [11], "campaignStatuses": ["running"]}

pageNo.description: Page number, 1 or greater. Default 1. Does not limit downloads.

noOfEntries.description: Rows per page. Default 50. Does not limit downloads, which contain up to 20,000 rows.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by: a dimension or metric key in the report, prefixed with "-" for descending or "+" for ascending (no prefix sorts descending). Only one field is used. Default "-impressions".

searchField.description: Text matched (case-insensitive, partial) against the names, and numeric IDs, of the report's dimension values, for example campaign names.

ExecuteRequestVO.description: Request to run a custom report: either a saved report by `id`, or an ad-hoc report defined in the request. Used by executeReportData and downloadReport.

id.description: Saved report ID. Execute and download: run the saved report with this ID; its saved definition replaces dimensions, columns, customerIds, startDate, endDate, timezoneId, timezoneName, requestType and reportAggregated, so none of those are needed. Duplicate: required; the report to copy. Ignored by create, and by edit (which takes the ID from the path).

reportName.description: Report name, up to 255 characters. Required when creating a report. Optional on duplicate (defaults to "Copy of <original name>") and edit. Download uses it in the file name and header; execute ignores it.

startDate.description: Start of the report date range as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds (not seconds). Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

endDate.description: End of the report date range as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds (not seconds). Must be after startDate and at most 365 days later. Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

dimensions.description: Dimensions to filter by. JSON-serialized array of objects, each with a mandatory `filter` and optional `value` array -- `filter` alone groups by that dimension; adding `value` restricts results to those specific values (only supported for dimensions where DimensionDetailsVO.isFilterSupported is true, per GET /api/v3/ra/report/dimension-metrics/detail; the server does not enforce this). `filter` must be an exact dimension `key` from that endpoint. Example JSON (before stringifying): [{"filter":"campaign"},{"filter":"gender","value":[10200002]}]. Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

customerIds.description: Customer (advertiser) organization IDs to include. Workspace users: must be customers assigned to the user; omit (or send [] on edit) to include all assigned customers. Advertiser users: ignored on create, execute and download, and must not be sent on edit.

items.description: Customer (advertiser) organization IDs to include. Workspace users: must be customers assigned to the user; omit (or send [] on edit) to include all assigned customers. Advertiser users: ignored on create, execute and download, and must not be sent on edit.

columns.description: List of columns to be included in the report. Must be exact `key` values from GET /api/v3/ra/report/dimension-metrics/detail's `metrics` -- each category in that array (e.g. "Counts") maps to a list of metric objects, and `key` is a field on each of those objects (e.g. "impressions", not "Impressions" or "impression count") -- there is no fuzzy or case-insensitive matching. Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`. Metrics that require the finance permission return 0 for users without it.

items.description: List of columns to be included in the report. Must be exact `key` values from GET /api/v3/ra/report/dimension-metrics/detail's `metrics` -- each category in that array (e.g. "Counts") maps to a list of metric objects, and `key` is a field on each of those objects (e.g. "impressions", not "Impressions" or "impression count") -- there is no fuzzy or case-insensitive matching. Required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`. Metrics that require the finance permission return 0 for users without it.

timezoneId.description: ID of the timezone for the report, e.g. 29 = US/Eastern. This is the timezone stored with a saved report. No default is applied if omitted: required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

requestType.description: Time breakdown of the report rows: 1=daily, 2=aggregated (no time breakdown), 3=weekly (Sunday-Saturday), 4=monthly. No default is applied if omitted: required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

reportAggregated.description: Aggregation of the report rows, as the string "0" or "1". "0" groups rows by every dimension. "1" aggregates over the first dimension: it is left out of the grouping and its columns are empty. No default is applied if omitted: required when creating a report, and when executing or downloading without `id`.

owId.description: Organization (OW) ID that owns the report. Set by the server from the caller's session.

createdByUOWId.description: User (UOW) ID that created the report. Set by the server.

modifiedByUOWId.description: User (UOW) ID that last modified the report. Set by the server.

timezoneName.description: Timezone name of the saved report, e.g. "US/Eastern". Returned by the server; not stored by create or edit (set timezoneId instead).

organizationName.description: Name of the organization. Set by the server; used in download file names.

customerDetails.description: Details of the report's customer organizations. Returned by the server; ignored in requests.

ReportDetailsVO.description: Saved custom report definition. Request body for creating, duplicating and editing a report, and the report returned by get and list operations.

dateRange.description: Date range for the row (weekly/monthly reports)

ModeledItem.description: Row item in the data array

totalRecords.description: Number of rows across all pages

filteredRecords.description: Number of rows across all pages; currently always equal to totalRecords

data.description: Report rows for the requested page: one per dimension combination, only rows with impressions. Omitted when there are no rows.

ModeledItemsData.description: Container for totals and row data

dateRange.description: Date range for the row (weekly/monthly reports)

message.example: Report schedule has been successfully updated.

deliveryFrequency.description: Delivery Frequency: 1 = once ; 2 = daily ; 3 = weekly ; 4 = monthly

deliveryDay.description: Delivery day (e.g. day of week or month depending on frequency)

CommonResponseMessage.description: Common response with data as message

url.description: URL of the downloadable report file
